_comment: Public affiliate IDs. Not secrets. Leave a value empty until the program approves you; a store without all its required IDs falls back to a plain, non-affiliate link. Kobo runs on Rakuten Advertising: kobo_partner_id is our Rakuten link ID and kobo_merchant_id 37217 is the approved Kobo US program (the Brazil program, 40380, is a separate approval and is not used). amazon_tag is the Amazon Associates store ID (for example yourname-20); it also covers Audible once an Audible link format from Associates is added to config/stores.json.
